story.originalTitle: Last night, celebrating the communities that come together to enjoy race week in Austin, their way. Thank you for inviting us into the spaces you've c...
story.summaryEn:
Last night, celebrating the communities that come together to enjoy race week in Austin, their way. 
Thank you for inviting us into the spaces you've created and sharing what brings you together.
#USGP
detailZh:
昨晚，庆祝那些聚集在一起享受奥斯汀赛车周的人们，以他们自己的方式。
感谢你们邀请我们进入你们创造的场所，分享你们聚集在一起的原因。
#美国大奖赛
detailEn:
Last night, celebrating the communities that come together to enjoy race week in Austin, their way. 
Thank you for inviting us into the spaces you've created and sharing what brings you together.
#USGP
